messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — link checker flagged a cluster of broken anchors in /docs/getting-started/index.md. CI posted the failure report.
docs-ci: LinkChecker job failed for branch main — 12 dead anchors detected in /docs/getting-started. Report: https://ci.redwood.example/reports/LC/2030056789 (summary attached)
maya: Minimal repro I ran locally: ```bash
rg "href=.*#" docs/getting-started -n || true
# then cross-check anchors: pandoc --toc -f markdown -t html docs/getting-started/index.md | rg "id=\""
```

samir: I can take the first pass. Will open small PRs to fix anchors and add redirects where needed. Do we want a single PR or multiple by page? :eyes:

eli: I can grab the section with the renamed headers (intro -> welcome). Looks like the autogenerated anchors changed when the headings were edited last week.

lina: I can update CDN redirect rules if we need shortlink fallbacks, but I need the exact old -> new anchor mapping. If PRs add redirects in frontmatter I can sync them in the CDN.

maya: Prefer multiple tiny PRs (one per page) so it's easy to review and revert. Samir — can you own coordinating and add the label `docs:triage`? I'll ping docs-rotation to re-run the scan after each PR. :thumbsup:

samir: Yep — assigning to myself. Plan: fix 3 pages now (getting-started + quickstart + auth), open PRs with short changelogs and add frontmatter redirects when possible. Will tag @lina for CDN sync if frontmatter redirects aren't feasible.

eli: FYI snippet that finds mismatched anchors: ```bash
# list headers and generated ids
python - <<'PY'
import re,sys
text=open('docs/getting-started/index.md').read()
for h in re.findall(r"^#{2,}\s*(.*)$", text, flags=re.M):
    print(h, re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9-]", "", h.lower().replace(' ', '-')))
PY
```

lina: Good call. If PR adds `redirect_from` frontmatter we can wire it in. Otherwise I can add proxy rules for the top problem anchors. No infra window required.

maya: Quick checklist before opening PRs:
1) run docs-ci linkcheck locally (docs/tools/linkcheck.sh)
2) add `redirect_from` keys for any removed anchor used in links
3) tiny changelog & reviewer: @eli or @maya
4) tag `docs:triage` and `team:platform` if CDN change needed

samir: On it — will push first PR in ~45m. Will paste PR link here when ready.

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — fixes three anchors in getting-started + frontmatter redirects. Requesting review from @eli. :party-parrot:

eli: Reviewing now. Quick note: there's also a hard-coded absolute link in examples/quickstart that points to the old anchor — I'll patch that in a follow-up.

maya: Great, thanks everyone. I'll re-run linkcheck once PRs merge and close the CI issue. If anything blocks, drop a note here and I'll escalate
__notes: This document is a Slack thread capturing an internal docs triage conversation. Messages are in-line as required by agents.md
